WebSession.name: correo-session
WebSession.description: Default cookie from the pinned public APP_NAME=Correo and session.php. Deployments may override SESSION_COOKIE/APP_NAME; the browser follows actual Set-Cookie, and application code must not hardcode this example name. Consent also requires CSRF.

x-contract-status: Proposed T-01 contract; independent review and implementation qualification pending

x-binding-policy.code_storage: Hash only; bind client, exact requested redirect, challenge, resource, grant and expiry; exchange and token creation commit atomically.
x-binding-policy.resource_validation: Require in authorize and token exchange, intended audience on every request. Google bearer, web cookies and account API keys never authenticate MCP.
x-binding-policy.revocation: Each call and locked mutation revalidates token/grant/user/account/live membership and scope intersection. Revoke grant invalidates all related tokens without waiting for a session to reconnect.
x-binding-policy.grant_reauthorization: No silent extension: each reauthorization creates a new consented grant with current membership/scopes; expired or revoked grants never become active again

x-client-profile.confidential_clients: Not enabled without demonstrated client requirement; metadata must not advertise unsupported methods.
x-client-profile.pre_registration: Supported for the inventoried clients, issuer-bound and administered locally.
x-client-profile.dynamic_registration: Implemented only with an explicit operator switch, quotas, client expiry/cleanup and redirect admission. Default off; metadata omits registration_endpoint.
x-client-profile.cimd: Not advertised. Pre-registration is available for known internal clients; arbitrary URL fetching would require an SSRF/cache/trust contract beyond this bounded initial profile.

x-redirect-policy.native_loopback: Only explicitly admitted clients may vary the port for an HTTP 127.0.0.1 or [::1] redirect. Host/path/query remain exact. localhost is a separately preregistered compatibility profile for clients that require it; it never aliases an IP literal.
x-redirect-policy.dynamic_clients: HTTPS redirect hosts must be operator-allowlisted. Loopback DCR profiles require explicit compatibility policy; application_type alone grants no exception.
x-redirect-policy.authorization_response: iss is always the exact configured issuer in successful and error redirects. state is preserved exactly when supplied. Unknown client/invalid redirect gets a local error, never a redirect.

x-input-policy.duplicate_decoded_names: reject invalid_request on public OAuth endpoints; consent has an explicitly validated form array for scopes
x-input-policy.empty_oauth_parameter_values: Treat empty form/query values as omitted before required-field checks. An empty optional state is omitted, never invented.
x-input-policy.unknown_oauth_parameters: ignore per OAuth; never persist/fetch/reflect unknown values
x-input-policy.recognized_unsupported_client_authentica: Reject Authorization header or nonempty client_secret/client_assertion fields with invalid_client; these are not unknown extensions to ignore.
x-input-policy.csrf: Mandatory on interactive consent; OAuth token/register/revoke have no web-session fallback.
x-input-policy.logging: Never log authorization headers, codes, verifiers, state, client/user secrets or full OAuth query/body; retain bounded correlation and safe error category.

x-open-design-items: Implement and qualify trusted HTTPS/cookies, redirects, Google return and actual client callbacks on both deployment profiles.
Implement atomic SQL admission/retention and protected cleanup, then prove limits with real negative/concurrent tests.
Qualify pinned MCP SDK protocol revisions, exact raw JSON validation, scope challenges and serialized result budgets.
Supply private Google credentials/operator sessions for actual Google/client proof; no simulated evidence substituted.

x-admission-policy.storage: SQL atomic windows; apply all relevant dimensions before side effects
x-admission-policy.ip_key: HMAC-SHA256 of normalized trusted peer IP and UTC day, using purpose-separated application key
x-admission-policy.trusted_proxy_policy: Only explicitly configured proxies; never trust arbitrary forwarded IP headers
x-admission-policy.business_quotas: Existing common account sending quotas remain additional limits; transport limits do not authorize mail
x-admission-policy.retry_after: Ceiling seconds to the latest exhausted window; HTTP429 before invocation, no business effect

x-retention-policy.preregistered_client_expiry: Explicit operator revocation; no idle expiration
x-retention-policy.accepted_source_exception: Preserve immutable receipt and provenance tombstones while accepted work refers to them; no cascading loss of accepted work
x-retention-policy.cleanup: Bounded finite command, scheduled through existing scheduler; expire/revoke atomically before deletion, preserve active work and source references

x-key-lifecycle.opaque_access_tokens: High-entropy Sanctum plaintext returned only once, SHA-256 hash persisted; no JWT signature/public JWKS invented
x-key-lifecycle.authorization_code: Cryptographic random code, hash only, 300 seconds, one atomic consumption; replay invalidates tokens from that code without disclosing token values
x-key-lifecycle.grant_reuse: No silent extension: each reauthorization creates a new consented grant with current membership/scopes; expired or revoked grants never become active again
x-key-lifecycle.application_key_rotation: Persist trusted current and previous Laravel encrypter keys; new cursors use current key, old cursors may decrypt only with configured previous keys. Keep previous key at least the 900-second cursor lifetime plus 30-second skew, then remove after expiry. Never accept cursor-provided keys.
x-key-lifecycle.emergency_rotation_or_restore: Atomically revoke all potentially compromised/restored MCP grants/tokens and pending codes, rotate private application/HMAC material, invalidate old cursor rings, then require new authorization; preserve immutable receipts/provenance
x-key-lifecycle.idempotency: Account namespace and canonical fingerprint never depend on APP_KEY, token, grant, client or transport; preserve T-17 receipts across rotation
